Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is looking for a Competitive Intelligence Director to define and operationalize a company-wide competitive intelligence function. This is an individual-contributor role with broad strategic scope: you will build the systems, workflows, and operating rhythms that turn fragmented market and competitor information into useful decisions for Product Management, Product Marketing, Campaigns, Sales, and Solutions Engineering.

You will help Horizon3 understand a competitive landscape that includes competitors at different stages of maturity, establish clear priorities across product domains, and make intelligence actionable. Your work will influence product strategy and roadmap discussions, sharpen market and campaign strategy, and give account executives and solutions engineers timely, credible guidance during active sales cycles.

What You’ll Do

Set the competitive-intelligence strategy

  • Own the company-wide strategy for competitive intelligence, including the priorities, principles, operating model, and ways of working that make intelligence useful across Horizon3.

  • Define how Horizon3 identifies, evaluates, tiers, and tracks competitors across product domains and stages of maturity.

  • Establish clear standards for source quality, confidence, recency, context, and responsible use of intelligence.

  • Partner with Product Management and Product Marketing leaders to focus research on the product areas, buyer needs, and competitors that matter most.

Build a scalable operating system

  • Create the processes, taxonomies, repositories, intake mechanisms, and dissemination cadences needed to scale competitive intelligence beyond one-off research requests.

  • Use AI tools to improve the collection, organization, synthesis, and distribution of competitive information while applying sound human judgment and maintaining claim integrity.

  • Develop repeatable methods for converting raw information into concise takeaways, implications, recommended actions, and points of view for specific audiences.

  • Create feedback loops so field questions, competitive objections, deal outcomes, product developments, and market changes continuously improve the intelligence function.

Turn intelligence into product and market decisions

  • Translate competitive findings into insights that help guide product strategy and roadmap discussions without owning the product roadmap.

  • Work with Product Management and Product Marketing in defined product areas to clarify differentiation, identify gaps, test assumptions, and sharpen positioning.

  • Identify patterns across competitor capabilities, messaging, packaging, go-to-market motions, and customer perceptions.

  • Help develop discrete takeaway campaigns and strategies in partnership with Campaigns, Product Management, and Product Marketing.

  • Develop an executive and leadership-network intelligence capability using appropriate professional and publicly available information: map relevant leadership relationships and prior company affiliations, track business outcomes, understand leadership priorities such as IPOs, private-equity transactions, hypergrowth, or fundraising, and monitor how those priorities and outcomes evolve over time. Use this insight to inform account strategy, executive engagement, positioning, and competitive planning without collecting or inferring sensitive personal information.

Enable revenue teams in the field

  • Equip account executives and solutions engineers with timely, practical guidance for active sales cycles, including competitor context, objection handling, differentiation, discovery prompts, and recommended next steps.

  • Create and maintain competitive enablement materials such as battlecards, comparison guidance, talk tracks, briefing materials, and sales plays.

  • Stay close to field feedback, customer and prospect conversations, competitive objections, win/loss patterns, and deal dynamics so the function reflects what is happening in the market.

  • Help teams distinguish durable competitive insight from anecdote, outdated information, or unsupported claims.

Make intelligence visible and actionable

  • Design dissemination approaches that deliver the right level of detail to the right audience, from executive decisions and product planning to campaign development and deal support.

  • Build clear communication rhythms and points of access so competitive intelligence is discoverable, current, and easy to use.

  • Measure the usefulness and adoption of the function through feedback, engagement, asset usage, field impact, and the quality of decisions it supports.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience building, leading, or operating a competitive-intelligence, market-intelligence, strategy, product marketing, or closely related function in a complex B2B technology environment.

  • A track record of turning disparate market and competitor information into clear recommendations for product, marketing, and revenue stakeholders.

  • Experience designing scalable research and knowledge workflows, including prioritization, categorization, synthesis, and dissemination.

  • Practical experience using AI-enabled tools to improve research, analysis, knowledge management, or information distribution.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work credibly with Product Management, Product Marketing, Campaigns, Sales, and Solutions Engineering.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to move between executive-level synthesis, product detail, and field-ready guidance.

  • Sound judgment about evidence, uncertainty, confidentiality, and the difference between a useful insight and an unverified claim.

  • The ability to work independently, create structure in an ambiguous environment, and drive outcomes across teams without relying on formal authority.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise infrastructure, cloud, identity, application security, exposure management, or a related technical market.

  • Experience supporting competitive selling, win/loss analysis, deal strategy, sales enablement, or field intelligence.

  • Experience partnering with product teams on market requirements, product strategy, roadmap inputs, or competitive differentiation.

  • Experience building a competitive-intelligence function from an early stage or scaling one across multiple product lines.

  • Familiarity with research automation, knowledge-management systems, or AI-assisted intelligence workflows.

What We’re Looking For

  • You take ownership of the diagnosis, the next action, and the follow-through rather than waiting for a perfectly defined request.

  • You can move from strategy to operating detail: defining the model, building the workflow, producing the first useful asset, and improving the system from real feedback.

  • You are rigorous without being slow. You know when to go deep, when to state uncertainty clearly, and when a timely, decision-ready answer is more valuable than an exhaustive report.

  • You are commercially minded and connect intelligence to product choices, market positioning, campaign performance, sales productivity, and customer outcomes.

  • You stay close to the work: the product, the customer, the competitive claim, the field question, and the active deal.

  • You communicate with precision and adapt your message for executives, product leaders, marketers, account executives, and technical evaluators.

  • You build trust through accuracy, context, responsiveness, and respect for different functional perspectives.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $209,000 - $274,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Bonus opportunity: Eligible for an annual performance bonus target of 20%.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
